title: epipactis pusilla
intro: Epipactis pusilla, commonly known as the small helleborine, is a species of orchid native to Europe, western Asia, and North Africa. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, including its potential to reduce inflammation and improve respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Epipactis pusilla are attributed to its ability to inhibit the growth of bacteria and viruses, making it useful in treating infections. The bioactive constituents of Epipactis pusilla include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other compounds that contribute to its medicinal properties.
